# claude-bootstrap

> Python CLI that scaffolds Claude Code projects from the detected project type. A layer above `superpowers` (it declares the dependency rather than competing with it). Emits a layered CLAUDE.md, `.claude/settings.json` (permission baseline), license-audited skill bundles (MIT / Apache-2.0) per profile, and hierarchical per-subdirectory CLAUDE.md files in monorepos. Detection-first, profile-based, idempotent, with a reversible manifest and skill provenance auditing. Status: `1.0.0` (first public release, 2026-08-11) — 6 profiles (universal-software, frontend, backend, data-science, devops, academic), 30 bundled skills (25 vendored under a commit pin + 5 first-party MIT), suite green.

- [Anthropic's canonical Claude Code pattern](docs/01-canonical-anthropic.md): memory, skills, agents, hooks, MCP, plugins, settings hierarchy
- [State of the art](docs/02-state-of-the-art.md): consensus practices, emerging ones, and anti-patterns
- [Anti-patterns](docs/03-anti-patterns.md): what to avoid when configuring Claude Code
- [Curated skills](docs/04-skills-curated.md): the bundled skills, their provenance and their licences per profile
- [Profiles](docs/05-profiles.md): the 6 profiles, skills per profile, permission baselines
- [Bootstrap flow](docs/06-bootstrap-flow.md): detect -> interview -> install -> doctor -> audit -> uninstall
- [Glossary](docs/07-glossary.md): canonical Claude Code domain terms
- [FAQ](docs/08-faq.md): frequent questions, including multi-profile monorepo support

English is canonical. A Portuguese mirror of all nine documents lives at [docs/pt-br/](docs/pt-br/README.md).
